title: Shing Jea armor
wikitext:
*Available as starting armor for Factions characters. ''(Note: The names of starter armor are in brackets)''
*Available from various collectors on [[Shing Jea Island]].
*Crafted by [[Moon Ahn]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]], [[Seiji]] in [[Ran Musu Gardens]], [[Lain]] in [[Seitung Harbor]] and [[Ryoko]] in [[Kaineng Center]].
